overall.comments: The 'not ready to release' verdict and next steps (fix access problems, then tax and quantities, then re-run) are clear. As a manager I'd hand it to a developer. Some terms ('Behind the screens', 'session', 'local demo', 'environment') and the lower-priority technical items are less clear, and I'd need to ask who owns the fixes and when.

detail.title: Any customer who signs in can read the personal details of all other customers
confusing_words: Behind the screens (the part that talks to the Client Portal)
detail.comments: Clear that customers can see other customers' private data and that this is serious. 'Legal exposure' is a bit vague but understandable as a risk to the company. I can't check it myself and would need a developer.

detail.title: A customer can view another company's order by changing the number in the page address
detail.comments: Steps are mostly followable, but step 2 is a little fiddly: I would have to know where the 'address bar' is and how to edit the end of the address. It also assumes I have a Zain Traders login and that the order 1039 exists in my environment. I understand that competitors could see each other's purchases.

detail.title: Customers with large orders are charged too much tax
confusing_words: worked out on the price before the discount
detail.comments: Steps are simple and the expected total of $1,045 versus the shown $1,050 is easy to compare. I need a test login, which the report explains how to get. The tax-versus-discount explanation is slightly abstract but the example makes it clear.

detail.title: After signing out, the old sign-in can still be used
confusing_words: Behind the screens (the part that talks to the Client Portal)
detail.comments: I get the gist (logging out doesn't fully log you out), but 'session' and 'copied sign-in' are not explained, so I couldn't explain it to someone else. 'Every user' is clear.

detail.title: The system accepts orders with impossible quantities, including negative ones
confusing_words: Behind the screens (the part that talks to the Client Portal)
detail.comments: Easy to understand that negative or absurd orders are being accepted and distort totals and sales figures. 'Fractional' is slightly unclear. It is not obvious whether a normal customer can do this on screen or only through technical means.

detail.title: Searching My orders can show an old status
confusing_words: Behind the screens (the part that talks to the Client Portal)
the browser pages that use search would show an old value
detail.comments: The idea is clear: search shows an outdated status. The last part of the 'who is affected' line is confusing. How often it happens ('can show') is vague.

detail.title: On a phone, the My orders page hides part of the first order and the Total column
confusing_words: nothing showing that more can be scrolled
detail.comments: I could follow it by narrowing the window or using a phone, though 'pixels' means nothing to me and I'd just use my phone. The screenshot helps.

detail.title: Certain searches or page settings make the order list fail
confusing_words: Behind the screens (the part that talks to the Client Portal)
detail.comments: I don't know what 'fail' looks like to a user (error page? blank?) or how likely people are to type a bracket. The 'zero items per page' setting is not something I know how to set. Why it matters is weak.

detail.title: Error messages reveal internal technical details
confusing_words: Behind the screens (the part that talks to the Client Portal)
location of files on the server
detail.comments: 'The company's security' is too general. I understand it as 'the system says too much when it breaks', but I can't judge the real risk or who is hurt.

detail.title: A double click can place the same order twice
confusing_words: Behind the screens (the part that talks to the Client Portal)
detail.comments: The double-billing risk is clear. However, the report says it's a 'double click' yet also says it cannot be seen on screen, which is confusing. The 'unsure about repeated references' note leaves me unsure whether this is really a problem.

detail.title: Some buttons on the admin Orders page cannot be understood by screen readers
detail.comments: I understand that blind staff can't tell what some buttons do. 'Screen readers' is partly explained by 'software that reads the screen aloud'. I don't know whether we have such staff, so urgency is unclear.

detail.title: The sales report is slow to appear
detail.comments: Simple steps and an easy-to-observe result. Needs an admin login. There is no screenshot, but none is needed.

detail.problem: 🔴 Critical: A customer can view another company's order by changing the number in the page address
detail.notes: I signed in as the Zain Traders customer and opened order.html?id=o-1039. The page showed only "Order not found." with no items, prices or totals, and nothing from Acme's order QA-iso-1. That is the correct refusal, so I did not see the reported problem. Step 2 didn't give the full address, so I used the address format from the My orders links (order.html?id=o-XXXX).
